text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
“—Tokai Teio comes from the outside! 
Already fighting for the lead! Under 400 
meters to go, charging up the slope!”

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—She's cleared the uphill slope!! Tokai 
Teio is in the lead!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: —Haaaaahhh!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And Tokai Teio is on the verge of the 
Double Crown! A lead of three, now four 
lengths!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—An overwhelming victory!! Tokai Teio 
crosses the finish line!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa! Teio! Teio-o-o!! Amazing, amazing, 
amaziiing!!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: What a run—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Today, I accompanied Ikuno Dictus and 
her friend to watch the Japan Derby, but—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tokai Teio's running was so overwhelming, 
I found myself shivering at her 
brilliance...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
—That's so incredible. With this, Teio's 
an undefeated double crown winner~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: ......Nature?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: —Eh, ah.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah! An undefeated Double Crown? 
Talk about laying on the achievements too 
thick! Good grief, I'm totally at your 
mercy here~.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Honestly... you're unbelievable—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Heheh—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ...Just my imagination, maybe?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, thank you, everyoneee!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing Tokai Teio standing in the winner's 
circle, something... felt intensely out of 
place.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Teio-san...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The strange feeling that Ikuno Dictus and 
I felt at that moment would soon reveal 
its true nature in the days to come.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...In the worst possible way.

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
—Ehh—!? Teio got a fracture?! You gotta be 
kidding me, give me a break already...!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
My dream of becoming an undefeated Triple 
Crown Umamusume is gone... I'm so 
shocked...

text_block_list.name: Race Fan C
text_block_list.text:
You're seriously not gonna make it in time 
for the Kikuka Sho either? No waaaay...

text_block_list.name: Race Fan D
text_block_list.text:
"...You won't just never come back or 
anything, right? You'll be fine, right?"

text_block_list.name: Race Fan C
text_block_list.text: Hey! Seriously, don't jinx it!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
――No no no!! I don't want Teio to be 
hurt!! Please run more--!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Aaargh, honestly! Throwing a tantrum won't 
change the fact that you're injured!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Besides... the one hurting the most from 
the injury... is her, after all—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
...Still, it's such a shame, isn't it? All 
the fans were looking forward to seeing 
Teio so, so much.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...Indeed.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Geez. Isn't everyone being way too gloomy 
all over the place?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"I really wish people wouldn't throw a 
pity party behind my back, you know~"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Teio...! Why the heck are you—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"I kind of sensed you talking about me 
with such a gloomy look on your face~ So, 
well, I just couldn't help myself."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I mean— I'm totally raring to make a 
comeback, you know? Don't be down, look 
forward to that instead!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Uh—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Comeback!? Teio, is your injury healed!? 
Are you coming back right away!? 
Tomorrow!?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"No, tomorrow's impossible! In fact, it's 
more like a six-month recovery, but—"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Well, I could cure it way faster. After 
all, nothing is impossible for the great 
me~!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Ooooh!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Well then, well then! Once you're healed, 
run with Turbo! We're definitely, 
definitely gonna race!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Ehh? Do you really think you can keep up 
with me~?"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
What the heck! While you're not running, 
Teio, Turbo's gonna get crazy fast, just 
watch!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
...Teio's bursting with way more energy 
than I expected, huh? Guess there's no 
need to worry after all.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
—...Well, if they're saying it themselves, 
then... I guess that's how it is?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
—Is that so? To think Teio-san would say 
something like that...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...McQueen-san, you've been concerned 
about Teio-san's running for quite some 
time, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...Indeed, that is true.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Because it simply caught my eye.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
The sight of her, displaying her talent 
with youthful vigor.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...Though our debut dates differ, she and 
I are runners who grace the turf in the 
same era.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"If our hoofprints ever cross, and we have 
the chance to vie for supremacy..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
She wanted to face that running style 
head-on, purely as an Umamusume herself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...I can't help but feel that way, too.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...I feel the exact same way.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Oh my. In that case, it wouldn't be a bad 
idea for us to light a fire under Teio-san 
ourselves."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
If we can deliver a run so breathtaking 
that it makes everyone forget her 
radiance—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps Teio-san will find the motivation 
for her comeback in her desire to defeat 
us.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. That's such a McQueen-san way of 
cheering someone on.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(...Teio-san. Please, stay strong just as 
you are.)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(I know you haven't given it your all yet. 
That's why... you should come back—)

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...What am I doing? Just standing still 
like this...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
This is no time to be feeling gloomy, 
though—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That murmur faded away on the empty track, 
unheard by anyone—
